items.title: 67250_John Collins oral history interview
items.q: We had a very good band... Prince Robinson... Panama France's, and I'm just naming some of the guys, to show you the calibre of band.

ctx.x: Talking about This wasn't Roy's Band?

Roy's Band, no. And what was Prince's name? Prince Robinson, also, fine saxophone player. Panama France's, and I'm just naming some of the guys, to show you the calibre of band. We had a very good band.
Can you remember the whole band?
